title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Parashat Beresheet"

chapters.title: Introduction to Beresheet
chapters.about: The beginning of the world and the structure of the first pasuk

chapters.title: The Farmer and the Shepherd
chapters.about: Comparing the agrarian and shepherd modalities in the Torah

chapters.title: The Story of Kayin and Hevel
chapters.about: Analyzing the birth of Kayin and Hevel and their respective professions

chapters.title: The Offering to Hashem
chapters.about: Why Hashem accepted Hevel's offering and rejected Kayin's

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the opening of Sefer Beresheet, focusing on the roles of the farmer and the shepherd in human development. She examines the story of Kayin and Hevel to understand why Hashem accepted Hevel's offering and rejected Kayin's, suggesting that true service involves innovation and bringing oneself to Hashem.
questions: Why does the Torah introduce the first men as farmers?
Does Hashem prefer the shepherd to the farmer?
Why was Hevel's offering accepted while Kayin's was not?
What does it mean to bring oneself to Hashem?
